Don't miss the Edmonton Oil Kings and Prince George Cougars as they battle it out in two exhibition games this September at the Tumbler Ridge Community Centre Arena. Tickets are on sale soon! Have you ever wanted to learn how to safely identify, harvest, and cook with wild plants from our region? Now's your chance! It’s time to dust off your clubs and join us for the TRORA Golf Tournament! This tournament is one of TRORA’s most important annual fundraisers, helping sustain our operations so we can continue supporting the outdoor recreation organizations that make Tumbler Ridge such an incredible place to live, work, and play. blurb: Located in a beautiful creek setting, this campground has 40 sites and is located just 1 km from town. Amenities include; fire pits, firewood, a cooking shelter, picnic areas, playground, hiking trails and swimming hole. Also on site: a sani-station, flush toilets and hot showers. No hook-ups, pets welcome. Open from May to October. Online booking is now available.
